candidates.name: Gojek Group
candidates.description: Gojek operates as a direct peer superapp providing ride-hailing, food delivery, and digital financial services in Southeast Asia.
candidates.rationale: Direct super-app peer in Southeast Asia with overlapping ride-hailing, delivery, and financial services; same customer base and business model.

candidates.name: Careem
candidates.description: Careem is a multi-service superapp offering mobility, food delivery, and payment solutions in the Middle East.
candidates.rationale: Same super-app model: mobility, delivery, and payments; comparable regional consumer base and B2B merchant/payment services.

candidates.name: Bolt Technology OÜ
candidates.description: Bolt is a broad mobility-as-a-service provider that integrates ride-hailing, food delivery, and grocery services into one platform.
candidates.rationale: Same super-app model: ride-hailing plus delivery services, targeting similar consumers and merchants in adjacent regional markets.

candidates.name: Uber Technologies
candidates.description: Uber is a global leader in ride-hailing and food delivery, sharing the core on-demand marketplace model used by the source.
candidates.rationale: Same core on-demand mobility and delivery platform; comparable marketplace model and buyer/customer overlap.

candidates.name: Yori
candidates.description: Yori is positioned as a superapp that integrates rides, deliveries, and commerce services similar to the source model.
candidates.rationale: Also a super-app combining rides, deliveries, and commerce; same business model and comparable buyer personas.

candidates.name: wownow-kh
candidates.description: WOWNOW provides a multi-service digital ecosystem integrating lifestyle services, food delivery, and logistics.
candidates.rationale: Both are Southeast Asian super-apps combining delivery, logistics, and lifestyle services for similar consumers and merchants.

candidates.name: Nonstopcourier
candidates.description: Nonstop.asia operates as a local superapp providing an integrated suite of services including taxi, courier, and ticketing.
candidates.rationale: Local super-app with taxi, courier, and ticketing services; same platform model and similar customer base as Grab.

candidates.name: Mapplate by eCommerce Gateway Inc.
candidates.description: Mapplate serves as an everything app offering food, groceries, and service booking on a single platform.
candidates.rationale: Both are super-app marketplaces combining mobility/delivery/services for consumers and merchants, with similar platform business models.

candidates.name: Xpress
candidates.description: Xpress acts as a mobility-focused super app offering comprehensive urban transportation and delivery solutions.
candidates.rationale: Mobility super-app with transportation and delivery services in Southeast Asia; closely matches Grab’s core business model and buyer set.

candidates.name: Society Pass inc
candidates.description: SocietyPass builds a digital ecosystem integrating loyalty and lifestyle services into a single unified platform.
candidates.rationale: Similar Southeast Asian consumer super-app/platform with payments, loyalty, and lifestyle services; comparable digital ecosystem model and buyer base.

candidates.name: Halen Group
candidates.description: Halen operates a community-based super app model that bundles various daily services for users.
candidates.rationale: Community-based super-app bundling daily consumer services is a strong model match to Grab's regional super-app business.

candidates.name: U-Pay Digital Plc.
candidates.description: U-PAY functions as a one-stop digital life platform encompassing payment services and consumer daily life utilities.
candidates.rationale: Similar super-app/digital payments platform serving consumers and merchants; same category and buyer persona.

candidates.name: Tata Group
candidates.description: Tata Neu provides an integrated ecosystem linking retail, finance, and travel services under one application.
candidates.rationale: Tata Group is a conglomerate; Tata Neu is a retail-led consumer app, not a Southeast Asian ride-hailing/delivery/payments super-app peer.

candidates.name: Nestia Pte Ltd.
candidates.description: Nestia is a platform for local lifestyle services, including transport, news, and utility management.
candidates.rationale: Lifestyle services platform, not a comparable super-app with Grab’s scale, payments, delivery, and financial services.

candidates.name: Squch Technologies LLC
candidates.description: Squch markets itself as a super application aiming to provide comprehensive digital service functionality.
candidates.rationale: Both are super-app businesses bundling multiple consumer and merchant services; same model and buyer categories.

candidates.name: DoorDash
candidates.description: DoorDash offers on-demand logistics, food, and grocery delivery which are key pillars of the source's marketplace model.
candidates.rationale: Same super-app/on-demand marketplace model: delivery, logistics, and platform services for consumers and merchants.

candidates.name: Foodpanda
candidates.description: Foodpanda provides widespread food and grocery delivery services across Asia, mirroring a core operational segment of the source.
candidates.rationale: Same regional consumer delivery platform with overlapping customers, merchants, and logistics operations; similar scale and buyer personas.

candidates.name: Swiggy
candidates.description: Swiggy is a major platform for food and quick commerce, sharing the same on-demand delivery business model.
candidates.rationale: Same on-demand super-app/delivery model, comparable consumer and merchant audiences, and similar platform-based services.

candidates.name: Glovo
candidates.description: Glovo is a multi-category on-demand delivery app that allows users to order various goods and food items.
candidates.rationale: Glovo is a similar super-app style on-demand delivery platform with overlapping consumer, merchant, and logistics business models.

candidates.name: Talabat General Trading and Contracting Company
candidates.description: Talabat operates as a prominent on-demand food and grocery delivery platform in the Middle East.
candidates.rationale: Same on-demand delivery marketplace model, serving consumers and merchants in a comparable regional super-app/delivery category.
